description: Whatever has an inclination following an intelligible form has will, through an appetitive principle following intellect as the middle term: such an inclination belongs to an appetitive principle that follows intellectual apprehension (OPEN q.80 a.1-2 reading), and whatever has such a principle has will (OPEN q.80 a.2 / q.82 reading). It splits the near-definitional recognition step into the appetite classification and the identification of intellectual appetite with will.
